name: BOBILib
description: Abstract In this report, we present the , a collection of more than 2600 instances of mixed integer bilevel linear optimization problems (MIBLPs). The goal of this library is to provide a large and well-curated set of test instances freely available for the research community so that new and existing algorithms in bilevel optimization can be tested and compared in a standardized way. The library is sub-divided into instances of different types and also contains different benchmark instance sets.
